sentences.text: The Independent Commission Against Corruption prepared this staff questionnaire to research public sector corruption risks and their management.
sentences.support:
The Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) is researching corruption 
risks and risk management within the public sector.

sentences.text: The questionnaire was sent to about 1200 randomly selected employees from about 30 public sector organisations.
sentences.support:
A second questionnaire has been sent to approximately 1200 randomly 
selected employees from approximately 30 public sector organisations.

sentences.text: It asks employees about codes of conduct, gifts, access to electronic services and internal channels for reporting misconduct.
sentences.support:
Does your organisation have a channel for internal reporting of misconduct or 
staff wrongdoing?

notes: This source is a blank staff survey instrument, not a results report. It has no executive summary, findings or recommendations.
